description: This file defines the AutocompleteLoggingService class, which manages autocomplete outcome logging, abort controllers, and rejection timeouts for code completion features.

classes.name: AutocompleteLoggingService
classes.description: A service class for logging autocomplete outcomes, managing abort controllers, and handling rejection timeouts.

methods.name: createAbortController
methods.description: Creates and stores a new AbortController for a given completion ID.

methods.name: deleteAbortController
methods.description: Deletes the AbortController associated with a given completion ID.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Aborts all active abort controllers and clears the collection.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Marks a completion as accepted, logs the outcome, and removes associated timeouts.

methods.name: cancelRejectionTimeout
methods.description: Cancels the rejection timeout for a given completion ID and removes the outcome.

methods.name: markDisplayed
methods.description: Marks a completion as displayed, sets a rejection timeout, and manages continuation logic.

methods.name: logAutocompleteOutcome
methods.description: Logs the autocomplete outcome to the console unless in test environment.
